transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I issue today's vehicle assignments and dispatch board, we'll conduct our standard transport-board huddle. I need the transportation, medical, signal, and engineer representatives to report any load requirements or vehicle-control considerations for today's four moves: clinic cold-storage cases to the medical annex, the communications mast to the north relay point, the generator to the engineering yard, and the routine administrative pallets to the headquarters warehouse. Please share any constraints or special requirements so I can assign the right vehicle to each move.

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to report a load requirement for the communications mast move. Our transportation section's load sheet confirms the mast is 24 feet long and must be carried on flatbed F-7 with its approved tie-down kit. I received the corrected dimensions during yesterday's vehicle check, but the revised load sheet hasn't been posted to the dispatch board yet.
